content.title: About
content.content: Fajita is a ready‑to‑use spice blend created by NFS for preparing the Mexican dish “fajita”. The mix includes dried chilies, paprika, garlic, onion and aromatic herbs that give meat, fish or vegetables a characteristic spicy flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “fajita” comes from the Spanish word meaning “strip” or “ribbon”, referring to the traditional cut of meat.
The NFS blend is formulated to balance heat and aroma, making it suitable for both classic and modern recipes.
The product contains no artificial colours or preservatives.
Fajita NFS is suitable for home cooking as well as professional restaurant use.
One package is designed for 30‑50 servings, depending on the amount of protein used.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: The blend contains paprika and dried chilies, which are high in vitamins C and E, helping protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Cumin and garlic stimulate gastric juice production, aiding digestion.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: No added sugars are present, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Spiciness
items.content: The blend can be hot; people with sensitive stomachs should use it sparingly.

items.title: Allergy to spices
items.content: Contains garlic and cumin, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The mix includes salt; those limiting sodium intake should account for it in their overall diet.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add 1‑2 teaspoons of the blend to 500 g of meat, fish or vegetables, and sauté over high heat until a golden crust forms. It can also be used in marinades, sauces and soups to boost flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the packet in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, seal tightly to preserve aroma. Shelf life is indicated on the label.
